title: Ideal simple pendulum model
description: The renderer-neutral, undamped point-mass pendulum model released from rest. Time is measured in seconds from release.

lengthMeters.description: Distance from pivot to point mass, in metres.

gravityMetersPerSecondSquared.description: Magnitude of the uniform acceleration in the negative Y direction, in m/s².

angleRadians.description: From vertically down, positive toward +X, in radians. The inverted position is outside this release model.
